K9 Partners for Patriots, a Florida-based, veteran-led nonprofit that is saving lives and restoring independence for veterans suffering from PTSD, traumatic brain injury, and military sexual trauma.

K9 Partners for Patriots pairs veterans with carefully selected rescue dogs and provides each team with six months of professional service dog training—at absolutely no cost to the veteran. The organization’s holistic approach includes mental health support, peer connection, and lifelong guidance. Their work is not only compassionate, it is effective. Hundreds of Florida veterans have graduated from the program with life-changing results: reduced suicide risk, increased independence, and renewed hope for the future.
